en.text: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a message was revealed to Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the message was true, even a great warfare. He understood the message, and had understanding of the vision.

zhSimplified.text: 波斯王塞鲁士第三年，有事显给称为伯提沙撒的但以理。这事是真的，是指着大争战；但以理通达这事，明白这异象。

zhTraditional.text: 波斯王塞魯士第三年，有事顯給稱為伯提沙撒的但以理。這事是真的，是指着大爭戰；但以理通達這事，明白這異象。

en.text: In those days I, Daniel, was mourning three whole weeks.

zhSimplified.text: 当那时，我—但以理悲伤了三个七日。

zhTraditional.text: 當那時，我－但以理悲傷了三個七日。

en.text: I ate no pleasant food. No meat or wine came into my mouth. I didn’t anoint myself at all, until three whole weeks were fulfilled.

zhSimplified.text: 美味我没有吃，酒肉没有入我的口，也没有用油抹我的身，直到满了三个七日。

zhTraditional.text: 美味我沒有吃，酒肉沒有入我的口，也沒有用油抹我的身，直到滿了三個七日。

en.text: In the twenty-fourth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, which is Hiddekel,

zhSimplified.text: 正月二十四日，我在底格里斯大河边，

zhTraditional.text: 正月二十四日，我在底格里斯大河邊，

en.text: I lifted up my eyes and looked, and behold, there was a man clothed in linen, whose waist was adorned with pure gold of Uphaz.

zhSimplified.text: 举目观看，见有一人身穿细麻衣，腰束乌法精金带。

zhTraditional.text: 舉目觀看，見有一人身穿細麻衣，腰束烏法精金帶。

en.text: His body also was like beryl, and his face as the appearance of lightning, and his eyes as flaming torches. His arms and his feet were like burnished bronze. The voice of his words was like the voice of a multitude.

zhSimplified.text: 他身体如水苍玉，面貌如闪电，眼目如火把，手和脚如光明的铜，说话的声音如大众的声音。

zhTraditional.text: 他身體如水蒼玉，面貌如閃電，眼目如火把，手和腳如光明的銅，說話的聲音如大眾的聲音。

en.text: I, Daniel, alone saw the vision, for the men who were with me didn’t see the vision, but a great quaking fell on them, and they fled to hide themselves.

zhSimplified.text: 这异象惟有我—但以理一人看见，同着我的人没有看见。他们却大大战兢，逃跑隐藏，

zhTraditional.text: 這異象惟有我－但以理一人看見，同着我的人沒有看見。他們卻大大戰兢，逃跑隱藏，

en.text: So I was left alone and saw this great vision. No strength remained in me; for my face grew deathly pale, and I retained no strength.

zhSimplified.text: 只剩下我一人。我见了这大异象便浑身无力，面貌失色，毫无气力。

zhTraditional.text: 只剩下我一人。我見了這大異象便渾身無力，面貌失色，毫無氣力。

en.text: Yet I heard the voice of his words. When I heard the voice of his words, then I fell into a deep sleep on my face, with my face toward the ground.

zhSimplified.text: 我却听见他说话的声音，一听见就面伏在地沉睡了。

zhTraditional.text: 我卻聽見他說話的聲音，一聽見就面伏在地沉睡了。

en.text: Behold, a hand touched me, which set me on my knees and on the palms of my hands.

zhSimplified.text: 忽然，有一手按在我身上，使我用膝和手掌支持微起。

zhTraditional.text: 忽然，有一手按在我身上，使我用膝和手掌支持微起。

en.text: He said to me, “Daniel, you greatly beloved man, understand the words that I speak to you, and stand upright, for I have been sent to you, now.” When he had spoken this word to me, I stood trembling.

zhSimplified.text: 他对我说：「大蒙眷爱的但以理啊，要明白我与你所说的话，只管站起来，因为我现在奉差遣来到你这里。」他对我说这话，我便战战兢兢地立起来。

zhTraditional.text: 他對我說：「大蒙眷愛的但以理啊，要明白我與你所說的話，只管站起來，因為我現在奉差遣來到你這裏。」他對我說這話，我便戰戰兢兢地立起來。

en.text: Then he said to me, “Don’t be afraid, Daniel; for from the first day that you set your heart to understand, and to humble yourself before your God, your words were heard. I have come for your words’ sake.

zhSimplified.text: 他就说：「但以理啊，不要惧怕！因为从你第一日专心求明白将来的事，又在你 神面前刻苦己心，你的言语已蒙应允；我是因你的言语而来。

zhTraditional.text: 他就說：「但以理啊，不要懼怕！因為從你第一日專心求明白將來的事，又在你上帝面前刻苦己心，你的言語已蒙應允；我是因你的言語而來。

en.text: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me twenty-one days; but, behold, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me because I remained there with the kings of Persia.

zhSimplified.text: 但波斯国的魔君拦阻我二十一日。忽然有大君中的一位米迦勒来帮助我，我就停留在波斯诸王那里。

footnotes.text: - 10:13 就是天使长；二十一节同

zhTraditional.text: 但波斯國的魔君攔阻我二十一日。忽然有大君中的一位米迦勒來幫助我，我就停留在波斯諸王那裏。

footnotes.text: - 10:13 就是天使長；二十一節同

en.text: Now I have come to make you understand what will happen to your people in the latter days, for the vision is yet for many days.”

zhSimplified.text: 现在我来，要使你明白本国之民日后必遭遇的事，因为这异象关乎后来许多的日子。」

zhTraditional.text: 現在我來，要使你明白本國之民日後必遭遇的事，因為這異象關乎後來許多的日子。」

en.text: When he had spoken these words to me, I set my face toward the ground and was mute.

zhSimplified.text: 他向我这样说，我就脸面朝地，哑口无声。

zhTraditional.text: 他向我這樣說，我就臉面朝地，啞口無聲。

en.text: Behold, one in the likeness of the sons of men touched my lips. Then I opened my mouth, and spoke and said to him who stood before me, “My lord, by reason of the vision my sorrows have overtaken me, and I retain no strength.

zhSimplified.text: 不料，有一位像人的，摸我的嘴唇，我便开口向那站在我面前的说：「我主啊，因见这异象，我大大愁苦，毫无气力。

zhTraditional.text: 不料，有一位像人的，摸我的嘴唇，我便開口向那站在我面前的說：「我主啊，因見這異象，我大大愁苦，毫無氣力。

en.text: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? For as for me, immediately there remained no strength in me. There was no breath left in me.”

zhSimplified.text: 我主的仆人怎能与我主说话呢？我一见异象就浑身无力，毫无气息。」

zhTraditional.text: 我主的僕人怎能與我主說話呢？我一見異象就渾身無力，毫無氣息。」

en.text: Then one like the appearance of a man touched me again, and he strengthened me.

zhSimplified.text: 有一位形状像人的又摸我，使我有力量。

zhTraditional.text: 有一位形狀像人的又摸我，使我有力量。

en.text: He said, “Greatly beloved man, don’t be afraid. Peace be to you. Be strong. Yes, be strong.” When he spoke to me, I was strengthened, and said, “Let my lord speak, for you have strengthened me.”

zhSimplified.text: 他说：「大蒙眷爱的人哪，不要惧怕，愿你平安！你总要坚强。」他一向我说话，我便觉得有力量，说：「我主请说，因你使我有力量。」

zhTraditional.text: 他說：「大蒙眷愛的人哪，不要懼怕，願你平安！你總要堅強。」他一向我說話，我便覺得有力量，說：「我主請說，因你使我有力量。」

en.text: Then he said, “Do you know why I have come to you? Now I will return to fight with the prince of Persia. When I go out, behold, the prince of Greece will come.

zhSimplified.text: 他就说：「你知道我为何来见你吗？现在我要回去与波斯的魔君争战，我去后，希腊的魔君必来。

zhTraditional.text: 他就說：「你知道我為何來見你嗎？現在我要回去與波斯的魔君爭戰，我去後，希臘的魔君必來。

en.text: But I will tell you that which is inscribed in the writing of truth. There is no one who holds with me against these but Michael your prince.

zhSimplified.text: 但我要将那录在真确书上的事告诉你。除了你们的大君米迦勒之外，没有帮助我抵挡这两魔君的。」

zhTraditional.text: 但我要將那錄在真確書上的事告訴你。除了你們的大君米迦勒之外，沒有幫助我抵擋這兩魔君的。」
